description: Orderable products with prices in minor units, each with its barcode (gtin, 14 digits) where it has one and whether it is in stock. ids: read the live price of products a network showed you, before your person agrees; gtin: the products with that barcode, in any of its lengths. The price here is the one that counts.

gtin.description: Only products with this barcode (GTIN, EAN, UPC or ISBN), in any of its lengths. One that does not read as a barcode is refused.

ids.description: Only these products, by id (at most 50): read the live price of what a network showed you.

name: list_products
title: Products
